_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. family.co and the app.family.co login declare their token layers in their stylesheets (raw/css-vars.json, raw/app-css-vars.json): the marketing role layer and the app's --family-*/--wallet-*/--overlay-* product layer. Theme-invariant names land under core.*; names the app switches under [data-theme="dark"] are emitted under both light.* and dark.* as {var} leaves — the dark theme is declared, never painted while signed out. Measured roles under light.* alias the declared values where they match.
